note: Data of the viewer lenses (graph.lens, graph.extract.bodyhash). Editing it changes the facts of the extractors (bodyhash: part of the shard key) and the lens columns of the run.

dup.note: Duplicates lens: symbols whose normalised bodies (comments and whitespace gone, local names renamed by first occurrence, the symbol's own name left out) are identical. kinds: the symbol kinds that are compared. store_min: the extractors keep a body hash from this size on (smaller bodies are never compared; the size is ast nodes for python, tokens for the other languages). min_size: the smallest body that makes a group (per language, `default` for the rest); a group needs min_group symbols. max_groups / max_members / max_nodes: what the page lists (the rest is counted, never silently dropped: lens.dup.omitted).

norm.note: Text normalisation of the tree-sitter languages (the node text of a definition). comments: line prefixes and block pairs per language, `default` for the rest. params: where the parameter name stands in a parameter segment, name_first (name then type) or type_first (type then name). decl_kw: words after which an identifier is a new local; local_in: words after an identifier that make it a loop variable. A local is also a name followed by `=` or `:=` (not after `.`, `->`, `::`). Names that this misses stay as written: two bodies that differ only in such names are not reported (a missed duplicate, never a false one).

arch.note: Architecture lens: the module of a file is its directory cut to `depth` path segments (0 = the whole directory). Modules with fewer than min_nodes nodes are folded into their parent directory. Layers are the longest path from a module that nothing depends on (an edge a -> b: a uses b), over the condensation of the module graph; a strongly connected component of 2 or more modules is a cycle. max_modules: the page lists the largest modules, the rest is counted (lens.arch.omitted). edge_kinds: the node edge kinds that count as a dependency (empty = all).

health.note: Health lens: a score from 0 (bad) to 100 per module, 100 * (1 - sum(weights * penalties)), each penalty in 0..1. dead = (dead + dead-cluster + suspect symbols) / symbols; dup = symbols that sit in a duplicate group / symbols; fan = min(1, fan_out / fan_cap); cycle = 1 when the module is in a dependency cycle; size = min(1, symbols / size_cap). A module with fewer than min_symbols symbols has a score but is not ranked. grades: lower bound -> label, best first.
